configurations.name: backend
configurations._comment_canonical: CANONICAL_DATABASE_URL must be a REAL env var, not a .env line: canonical_ledger.py reads os.getenv at import, and pydantic's env_file populates settings, never os.environ. It is the RUNTIME credential (gex_app) on purpose — migration 053 owns the schema and gex_app holds no DDL, so the ledger writes rows under FORCED RLS. Do NOT point it at gex_user. GEX_CANONICAL_DEV=1 would instead waive Decision 4 onto an unruled SQLite file; it is deliberately not set here.

configurations.name: backend-verify
configurations._comment: A second backend on 8010 for verifying changes while someone else's backend holds 8000. Same database and credentials as 'backend'.

configurations.name: frontend-verify
configurations._comment: A second frontend on 3010 whose /api proxy targets backend-verify.
